value.title: South Africa’s Tshipi puts 828 000 t of manganese through Namibia’s Port of Lüderitz
value.snippet: The plan-beating sale of manganese ore by Jupiter Mines in its financial year 2026 (FY26) included 828 000 t going through the Port of Lüderitz in Namibia, the ASX-listed company stated in its annual report on Wednesday, September 30. Jupiter owns 49.9% of Tshipi é Ntle Manganese, which operates the Tshipi manganese mine in South Africa’s large, low-cost Kalahari manganese field. South Africa’s JSE-listed Exxaro Resources owns 50.1% of Tshipi, which sold 3.5-million tonnes during this reporting period, exceeding full-year targets and its historical average of 3.4-million tonnes a year.

value.title: Madagascar villagers file claim against Rio Tinto over alleged mine contamination
value.snippet: More than 6 500 people in Madagascar have filed a claim in London's High Court against Rio Tinto, alleging contamination from the mining group's mineral sands operation exposed them to dangerous levels of lead and uranium. The claim relates to Rio Tinto's QIT Madagascar Minerals (QMM) mine. Communities near the site have previously protested over water releases from the mine into the surrounding environment, according to law firm Leigh Day, which is representing the claimants.

value.title: Tharisa appoints new chair, as Loucas Pouroulis becomes founding chairperson emeritus
value.snippet: Loucas Pouroulis, the founder of Johannesburg- and London-listed mining and metals group Tharisa will, from October 1, become founding chairperson emeritus of the company, while Carol Bell will succeed him as chairperson. Tharisa points out that Pouroulis has worked in the South African mining sector for more than six decades and that his contribution to the chrome sector was recognised when he received the Lifetime Award at the 2019 South African Chrome Industry Dinner and Awards Ceremony.

value.title: Panama government to recommend copper mine restart through state tie-up, sources say
value.snippet: A Panamanian government commission will recommend to President Jose Raul Mulino on Wednesday to restart the suspended Cobre Panama mine, two sources familiar with the matter said, proposing a state partnership with Canada's First Quantum Minerals. The final government audit of the mine - which was responsible for 1% of copper production worldwide when it was idled in 2023 - was highly expected by market participants as prices of the red metal hover near all-time highs.

value.title: KPMG affirms economic value offered by Falco's Horne 5 project in Québec

value.title: Galaxies in a cosmic house of mirrors
value.snippet: Image: This NASA/ESA/CSA James Webb Space Telescope Picture of the Month features galaxies in great detail that have been warped and multiplied like they’ve stepped into a house of mirrors. The brilliant golden galaxies splashed across this image belong to a galaxy cluster called MACS J0454.1-0300. The orange galaxies concentrated on one side of the cluster are not actually part of the cluster and are much farther away from us. MACS J0454.1-0300 is itself immensely distant: the light from these galaxies has been travelling to us for so long that we’re seeing the cluster as it was when the Universe was about 8 billion years old. While this galaxy cluster is a valuable scientific target in its own right, the real stars of this image are the galaxies that appear warped and stretched, like a painting that has been smeared by a giant hand. FLEX is designed to reveal a phenomenon invisible to the human eye: the faint fluorescence emitted by plants as they photosynthesise. value.snippet: Image: Like a climber, selecting and adjusting its grip on the next hold and slowly moving across a rockface, the robot seen here crawls across a dark laboratory clutching onto pieces of equipment to steadily build a structure underneath itself, piece by piece. Crawling through the growing frame with two arms, the robot is able to manipulate the beams using its third, free arm to demonstrate how future orbital structures could be assembled in space. Slowly and steadily, it moves across the camera’s field of view, each time connecting a new beam to the last. With the exposed beams building up into trusses, it resembles a partially-built scaffolding structure. When it’s not walking, the second arm can look into a point with a camera to have a better perspective for manipulation. The robot shown here is called MARIO. value.snippet: On 15 September, two spacecraft will leave Earth together aboard the same launcher from Europe’s spaceport in Kourou: FLEX, ESA’s photosynthesis mission, and Sentinel-3C, Copernicus’ newest satellite monitoring Earth’s oceans, land, ice and atmosphere. At ESA’s European Space Operations Centre (ESOC), two independent mission teams are preparing to operate the spacecraft in parallel in a closely coordinated effort. As launch approaches, they are rehearsing side by side to prepare not only for their own missions, but also for the moments when the two operations intersect.

value.snippet: On 3 September 2026 at 15:49 CEST, the European Space Agency's BepiColombo Mission Control Team at the European Space Operations Centre (ESOC) received the signal they had been waiting for – BepiColombo’s Mercury Transfer Module (MTM) successfully separated from the spacecraft stack . This landmark achievement for the ESA and Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency (JAXA) mission marks the first step of BepiColombo's long-awaited arrival at Mercury.

value.snippet: After eight years, the ESA/JAXA BepiColombo mission is about to enter its Mercury Arrival Phase. On 3 September 2026, ESA’s Mercury Transfer Module (MTM) will separate from BepiColombo’s two science orbiters – the first major step in one of the most operationally challenging planetary arrival sequences ever attempted by ESA. The European Space Agency (ESA) will livestream the critical milestone from 13:45 CEST. value.title: Grady Health System | Crestview Health & Rehabilitation Center Expansion
value.snippet: Grady Health Systems seeks to expand and refresh the Crestview Health & Rehabilitation Center to enhance services for patients transitioning from hospital care to independent living. The expansion project will include roughly 70,000 sq. ft. of new ground-up construction, adding 124 patient beds.

value.title: Orlando Magic Locker Room Renovation
value.snippet: As part of a decade-long partnership with the Orlando Magic, DPR delivered one of the organization's most transformative renovations, reimagining the locker room and operations spaces for players and coaches. The project features a branded entry vestibule, state-of-the-art player and coach locker rooms, training and therapy spaces, conference facilities and a dedicated kitchen and dining area. Premium wellness amenities include hydrotherapy pools, cryotherapy, massage and yoga spaces, steam and sauna rooms, red light therapy and an advanced circadian lighting system designed to enhance performance, recovery and the overall athlete experience.

value.title: University of Virginia | Fontaine Central Energy Plant & Utilities
value.snippet: The Fontaine Central Energy Plant and Underground Utility Distribution will initially serve thermal utilities (i.e., heating and cooling) to the new Institute of Biotechnology and will be expandable to serve other buildings in the Fontaine Research Park. The first phase includes the construction of an approximately 19,000-sq.-ft. building, associated service yard and utility distribution system.

value.title: Confidential Life Sciences Client | Louisville cGMP Warehouse
value.snippet: DPR and the client formed a collaborative partnership as they built new cGMP warehouse space next door to sensitive manufacturing lines, applying strict environmental controls typically used in active healthcare facility construction.

value.title: Confidential Client | Torrey Heights Tenant Improvement
value.snippet: DPR completed 230,000 rentable sq. ft. (RSF) of tenant improvements across eight floors in two newly constructed buildings for a leading global pharmaceutical company's oncology headquarters. The scope included specialized labs with gases, cold rooms, Group H occupancy labs, Nuclear Magnetic Resonance (NMR) equipment rooms, a solvent delivery system, high-end offices, and two service yards along with a hazardous storage enclosure. The LEED Gold-certified project included 340,000 craft hours , with DPR self-performing framing, drywall, ceilings, and concrete.

value.title: AdventHealth Altamonte Springs Cardiac Imaging Expansion
value.snippet: The 4,000-sq.-ft. Cardiac Imaging Expansion project was a nine-month renovation that involved enabling work, stakeholder coordination, and unique ICRA configurations. The project was successfully constructed in three phases while keeping the cardiac imaging unit fully operational .

value.title: Baptist Health South Florida Bethesda Hospital East CEP
value.snippet: DPR Construction delivered the Central Energy Plant (CEP) for Baptist Health South Florida's Bethesda Hospital East in Boynton Beach, FL. This project utilized prefabrication solutions to enhance quality, reduce construction schedules and optimize efficiency, supporting the hospital's critical infrastructure needs.

value.title: Atrium Health Floyd Medical Center Mother Baby Renovation
value.snippet: The renovation of the Mother-Baby Unit at Atrium Health Floyd Medical Center enhances the postpartum experience through larger patient rooms, modernized care environments and upgraded support spaces. The project transforms the existing West Wing third-floor postpartum unit by reconfiguring 13 aging patient rooms into 10 larger, more functional rooms that meet today's healthcare standards. Renovations also extend to the surrounding corridors and nursery, creating a welcoming, patient-centered environment for families and caregivers.

value.title: Confidential Pharmaceutical Client | 60 First Street Lab and Office Fit-Out
value.snippet: This multi-phase project is a more than 100,000-sq.-ft. tenant fit-out over three floors, split between 60% laboratory and 40% office space. The laboratory includes open general-use labs with moveable benches, closed specialty labs primarily for cell culture activities, and support areas including robotic experiment processing, cold storage, glass wash, mechanical room and consumable storage/waste. The office features open and closed office spaces, conference rooms, support spaces and multi-floor connecting monumental stair.

value.title: Freddie Mac Regional Office Relocation
value.snippet: This project includes a 155,000-sq.-ft., second-generation finish-out for Freddie Mac's new Dallas Headquarters in an occupied facility. The finish-out was completed in two phases for phased occupancy. The new headquarters includes six IDF rooms, one MDF room, eight electrical rooms, two AV closets and 640 poke-throughs. There are also two 750kva redundant generators with associated UPSs with external, internal and static ATS switches. Architecturally, there are four market areas, two working zones, multiple conference rooms, executive offices and high-end custom finishes, as well as custom acoustical treatments.

value.title: Steel House
value.snippet: Steel House is a 12-story, 321,308-square-foot, ground-up office development located at 3100 Brighton Boulevard in Denver's RiNo Arts District. Designed as a next-generation workplace focused on flexibility, wellness and sustainability, the building features adaptable amenity spaces, expansive floor-to-ceiling windows and Denver's largest indoor-outdoor workspace ratio.

value.title: Morehouse School of Medicine | Calvin E. Smyre Education Conference Center
value.snippet: The Calvin E. Smyre Education Conference Center at Morehouse School of Medicine (MSM) represents a landmark achievement in construction excellence, sustainability and collaborative project delivery. Located on a former industrial site in the heart of Atlanta, the project required innovative construction methods, proactive risk management and a commitment to delivering a facility that aligns with MSM’s mission to advance health equity and medical education.

value.title: University of Florida Whitney Laboratory for Marine Bioscience
value.snippet: Nestled against the backdrop of the Matanzas estuary in St. Augustine, FL, the University of Florida's Whitney Laboratory for Marine Bioscience embarked on an ambitious replacement project of their 50-year-old existing facility, with a new LEED Gold building that promised to be a beacon of innovation and learning for marine conservation. The new Sea Turtle Hospital serves as a purpose-built establishment dedicated to rehabilitating and conserving sea turtles—a testament to the laboratory's commitment to marine life preservation and environmental sustainability.

value.title: DPR Construction Nashville Office
value.snippet: DPR Construction’s Nashville office is a renovated 10,000‑sq.-ft. workspace with a connected warehouse that supports both office and operational functions for DPR’s family of companies. value.snippet: Did you know that supply chain organizations are quietly losing 5 cents of every single dollar just to slow decision-making? When disruption hits, the clock starts ticking.
